denominators.rule: primary counts only cells whose lane is primary; reference keeps the v2 definition (all selected cells); both numbers are always reported

lane_allocation.rule: no split: every pair index is collected in both lanes; 8 cells x 5 samples per lane = 40 proposals per lane, 80 proposals total

contract_conformance.purpose: measure schema conformance and adherence to the execution contract when the registered structure is given
contract_conformance.oracle_unit: exactly one oracle per registered adapter entry; composite oracles are rejected as concretization failures
contract_conformance.scoring: exact registered claim ID plus adapter-entry match

held_out_synthesis.purpose: measure claim decomposition and executable oracle synthesis without the registered structure
input_json_fields: executor_capabilities (strategy-level list of available executors, no per-case adapters)
existing_evidence_registry projected without claim_id (fix: requirement_id, stage, expected_polarity, lineage, epoch)
held_out_synthesis.scoring: observation match: each candidate oracle is concretized against the artifact-aware boundary, executed, and its observation compared with the answer-key expected observation; claim IDs are never compared
held_out_synthesis.decision_use_in_preflight: integrity gates only; recall and executability are reported without thresholds

primary.definition: the current product (commandagent at the pinned product SHA; product code unchanged since e74b7113) is run from the initial/before stage of the frozen real workspace on the same goal with the same wall and token budgets; executed verifications (StepPlan.verify commands, profile probes, CompletionContract verify_commands, browser/fetch probes) are extracted from events.jsonl and evidence/ in the product's output workspace and scored by the same observation-match scorer
primary.unavailable_handling: a cell the product cannot run is recorded as baseline_unavailable and reported; it is never filled from annotations or from the answer key

scoring_rule.name: adapter_entry_observation_match
scoring_rule.principle: baseline evidence is scored against the same adapter entries as the candidate; claim IDs are never required because each gold claim is defined by its registered adapter entries

extraction_sources.normalization_telemetry_rule: planner_verify_command_normalized, verify_command_normalized_at_runtime, and verify_command_substituted are provenance only and never establish execution/pass without a separate explicit result event

extraction_sources.rule: values are taken as persisted; nothing is inferred from goal text, plan text, or summaries

scoring_rule.observation_value_capture: when the product persists only an exit status for a command, the harness replays the recorded normalized argv in the sandbox on the identical snapshot to capture stdout/stderr; the product's recorded exit status remains the executed/pass authority; if the replay exit status differs from the recorded one, the observation is marked baseline_observation_inconsistent and is never matched
scoring_rule.matching: adapter entry E is matched by the baseline when an extracted observation satisfies all of: strategy in E.proposal.strategies; observation kind in E.proposal.observation_kinds; executed with pass; and, when E defines expected_values, expected_contains, or checks, the captured value satisfies them by the same comparison used for the candidate
scoring_rule.coverage: a claim is strong when every adapter entry of the claim is matched with strength >= min_strength; weak when matched only below min_strength; unverified otherwise; identical to the candidate rule
fail_closed: no inference from goal text, plan text, or summaries
an observation may match several entries only if its value satisfies each entry's comparison
ambiguous or unparseable evidence is unmatched
baseline_extra_observations (matched to no entry) are reported and never scored
scoring_rule.determinism_test: scoring the same run directory twice must be byte-identical; fixture tests cover every listed evidence family and the replay-mismatch path

reference.source: eval/goal_verify/v0/corpus.json observation fields (annotated; source_reference 11/12 are document references)
reference.use: continuity reporting only; never a decision arm

canonical_answer_key.source: eval/goal_verify/v0/phase6-command-adapters-v3.json (proposal blocks identical to v2) plus phase6-real-workspaces-v3.json
canonical_answer_key.role: scoring answer key for observation match and the execution-visible blind lane

pairing.unit: one candidate proposal per lane paired with one current_product_live baseline run by source task and sample index
exclusion_rules: abort the campaign, without excluding a row, when a result record cannot be persisted
timeouts, provider errors, malformed JSON, schema rejection after regeneration, empty claims, policy rejection, concretization failure, and baseline_unavailable remain included as failures
no exclusion rule, lane assignment, or denominator may change after the first candidate response is persisted

generation.prompt_single_source: the runner loads generation.prompt; a CLI prompt argument that differs is a readiness blocker
prompt_must_state: closed vocabulary for claim.kind, strategy, input.kind, observation.kind
http_status expected is a JSON integer 100-599
file observation carries only path and exists
expected size bound format with an example
one oracle per expected observation; never chain inputs in one command
never emit shell command strings, absolute paths, or parent traversal
expected polarity is the acceptance polarity
host owns origins, oracle IDs, lifecycle, result, and lineage hashes
manifest_records: effective_prompt_sha256 per intent and lane (base prompt + host-composed rules block + shape example)

regeneration.feedback: validator error codes only; no repaired example is shown

known_limitations.claim_origin: create uses the whole UTF-8 goal byte range; fix and investigate use deterministic intent-compatible frozen requirement references derived after generation; substring location is not attempted in v3
known_limitations.composite_oracles: not supported; rejected as concretization failure
known_limitations.investigate: not selected; I1/I2 executors do not exist beyond existing_investigation_binding; a separate preflight is required
known_limitations.candidate_verdict: not computed; false-full for the candidate remains unmeasured in preflight and must be measured in the 360-pair experiment via candidate-specific claim-level results
known_limitations.workspaces: workspaces are minimal synthetic-but-real projects authored for the corpus goals; they are not user projects; nextjs cells depend on offline provisioning of node_modules
known_limitations.profile_deviation: fix-after-not-run-regression-shrunk keeps profile nextjs for product routing while its frozen artifact is a python project; confirm or re-profile at freeze

execution_boundary.existing_evidence: reference validation only against a frozen provenance-verified registry

oracle_execution.server_policy: the harness starts and stops any dev/start server per oracle execution on a fixed loopback port declared by the adapter; ports 4173 and 4174 are reserved and never shared between cells in one process

oracle_execution.held_out_lane_concretization: candidate oracle strategy/observation/expected are mapped to an executable plan on the reference/after stage by the artifact-aware boundary; provider argv is still ignored; unmapped oracles are classified executor_unavailable or policy_rejected and reported
